notes: CBS publishes four lists on one page (a consensus plus Eisenberg, Richard, Cummings). The three individual experts are used as separate sources; the consensus list is dropped to avoid double-counting.
The per-expert CBS URLs serve the same four embedded lists as the consensus URL, so all three experts now come from a single fetch per position.
FantasyPros in-season weekly pages have already flipped to Week 1. The draft cheat-sheet URLs (qb-cheatsheets, ppr-rb-cheatsheets, etc.) were used instead so the ranks remain preseason draft ranks.

Name matching now splits on hyphens and periods and collapses runs of single letters, so A.J. Brown, D.J. Moore, Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jacory Croskey-Merritt all resolve to one Sleeper record. Nickname aliases were added for Hollywood/Marquise Brown, Bam/Zonovan Knight and Juice/Antwane Wells.

Position is now taken from Sleeper for every matched player rather than from the source's own list, which eliminates cross-position duplicates at the source instead of resolving them afterward. FB is mapped to RB.

Rankings are redraft PPR. FantasyPros dynasty and superflex lists were reachable this run but are not blended in, because averaging dynasty ranks with redraft ranks would corrupt both. The dynasty leagues should lean on market_snapshot dyn_2qb_12tm_ppr1 for age-adjusted value.
Reachable but not used: RotoWire and NFL.com render rankings client-side; Yahoo, PFF, Draft Sharks and The Athletic remain paywalled or bot-gated.
